record.question: NATO and EU signed an agreement on 10th February, 2016 pertaining to
record.explanation: Answer A: Cyber Defense. The 10 February 2016 technical arrangement between NATO's incident-response capability and CERT-EU concerned cyber defence. NATO's own same-day release identifies its information-sharing and cyber-defence purpose. Reference: https://www.ncia.nato.int/about-us/newsroom/nato-and-the-european-union-enhance-cyber-defence-cooperation. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
